features.title: Group tasks by repository path
features.description: Allow tasks to be grouped in the sidebar by their repository path. This helps when managing multiple tasks across different projects. Groups should be collapsible and show task counts.

features.title: Filter tasks by repository path
features.description: Add a filter/search input in the sidebar to filter tasks by repository path. Users should be able to quickly find tasks for a specific project without scrolling through all tasks.

features.title: Support Claude Code slash commands
features.description: Integrate Claude Code's built-in slash commands (/commit, /pr, /review, /test, etc.) into the task interface. Allow users to send slash commands as follow-up prompts and handle their output appropriately.

features.title: Settings page with base repository directory
features.description: Add a settings page where users can select a base repository directory. When creating a new task, show a list of folders within that base directory (assumed to be repos) for quick selection, while still allowing the option to browse for another directory.

features.title: Continue conversation on follow-up
features.description: When sending a follow-up prompt to an existing task, use the Claude CLI '-c' flag to continue the conversation where it left off instead of starting fresh.

features.title: Remove restart button
features.description: Remove the restart button from the task detail view as it is no longer needed with the follow-up/continue functionality.

features.title: Rename delete to archive
features.description: Rename the 'Delete' action to 'Archive'. When archiving a task, remove the associated git worktree to clean up disk space.

features.title: Enhanced title, description, and branch generation
features.description: When creating a new task, spawn a lightweight Claude instance to generate a title, description, and branch name from the initial prompt. Settings page allows specifying a branch prefix. If prompt contains 'Work on task <ticket-id>', include ticket ID in branch name and title. Branch format: '<prefix>&<ticket>&<generated-name>' (use '&' instead of '/' for worktree compatibility). Handle branch name collisions by appending an integer.

features.title: Fix NVM shell environment in worktree
features.description: When changing directory to the worktree, ensure the shell properly loads nvm so the correct node version is used. Currently the shell environment extraction doesn't source nvm initialization, causing wrong node versions in the worktree shell.

features.title: Render Claude response without message box
features.description: Change the Claude response rendering to not be in a message box. Display the response content directly without the box styling for a cleaner output view.

features.title: Render thinking steps with accordion
features.description: Display thinking steps during Claude's response with an accordion component that allows users to expand and see more details about the thinking process. Parse thinking content from Claude's output and render it separately.

features.title: Render tool calls in response with details
features.description: Display tool calls in the response as they are executed. Include relevant details for each tool type - for example, for Read tool calls, show which file(s) are being read. Tool calls should appear inline in the response stream.

features.title: Mux protocol abstraction for AI tools
features.description: Create a Mux protocol/abstraction that provides an interface for response, thinking, and config based on the AI tool being used. This allows scaling Mux to work with Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding assistants.

features.title: Notifications for permissions and completion
features.description: Add support for system notifications when Claude needs permissions and when a task is done. This should be configurable in the settings panel, allowing users to enable/disable different notification types.

features.title: Permission request UI
features.description: Add support for prompting the user when Claude needs permissions during task execution. Show a UI element that allows the user to grant or deny the requested permission.

features.title: Remove recent tools list
features.description: Remove the recent tools list from the output view. This list is no longer needed and clutters the interface.

features.title: Terminal-style thick cursor
features.description: Make the cursor thick like a terminal block cursor when typing in input fields. This enhances the terminal aesthetic of the app.

features.title: Fix follow-up message ordering
features.description: Bug fix: Follow-up messages have responses rendered above the user message instead of below. The response should appear after the user's follow-up prompt.

features.title: Auto-allow permissions from Claude settings
features.description: Enhance the permission system to check Claude's .claude/settings.json permissions allow config before showing the dialog. Auto-allow if there's a match. Check settings in order: local (.claude/settings.local.json) > project (.claude/settings.json in project) > global (~/.claude/settings.json). Local overrides project, project overrides global.

features.title: Multi-select repo dropdown filter
features.description: Replace the text search filter in the sidebar with a multi-select dropdown of repositories. Users can select one or more repos to filter tasks.

features.title: Task view more button with Archive
features.description: Add a three-dot more button in task view that contains the 'Archive' action and other secondary actions.

features.title: Convert Create PR to View PR
features.description: Change 'Create PR' button to 'View PR' that links to the created PR. Button should be disabled if no PR has been created yet.

features.title: Open in VS Code/Cursor dropdown
features.description: Add an 'Open in' button with dropdown options for 'VS Code' and 'Cursor' to open the task worktree in the selected editor.

features.title: Takeover/Handback control
features.description: Add 'Takeover' and 'Handback' buttons. Takeover copies 'mux takeover <task-id>' to clipboard so user can paste in terminal. Handback copies 'mux handback <task-id>'. The mux CLI communicates with the desktop app via IPC to pause/resume Claude control.

features.title: Permission UI as task-scoped popover
features.description: Change permission dialog from a global overlay to a popover that appears near the message input only in the task that's asking for permission. Should not render on top of everything.

features.title: Permission request notification
features.description: Add system notification when a task asks for permission, so user is alerted even when not looking at that task. Also shows [?] indicator in sidebar for tasks with pending permissions.

features.title: Enhanced Diff Viewer / Code Reviewer
features.description: Full-featured code review tool with syntax highlighting (highlight.js), expandable context, file status icons, collapsible hunks, full-screen mode, line comments, checkbox selection, and send-to-agent functionality.

features.title: Slash commands in new task view
features.description: Support slash commands (/) in the new task prompt input. When a repository is selected, typing / shows available commands from project and global settings with autocomplete.

features.title: Onboarding flow
features.description: First-time user onboarding wizard with multiple steps: (1) Welcome screen - introduction to Mux and its capabilities; (2) Base repository directory - set up where repos live for quick selection in new task view; (3) Permission system - option to enable Claude settings-based permissions, with clear explanation that Mux will add the permission hook to their global ~/.claude/settings.json; (4) Branch prefix - configure naming convention for auto-generated branches; (5) Notifications - enable/configure system notifications for task completion and permission requests; (6) Optional quick tour - highlight key UI elements. Should detect first launch and show onboarding, with ability to access it again from settings.

features.title: Responsive diff view for smaller screens
features.description: On smaller screens, the diff/changes panel takes up too much space. Hide the changes panel by default on smaller viewports and show a toggle button to reveal it. The panel should slide in/out or appear as an overlay when toggled. Consider using a breakpoint (e.g., <1200px) to determine when to switch to collapsed mode.

features.title: Remove Create PR button
features.description: Remove the 'Create PR' button from the task view. Only show 'View PR' button if a PR has already been created (task.pr_url exists). Users should create PRs through slash commands or the Claude conversation instead.

features.title: Takeover/Handback copies CLI command
features.description: Changed Takeover and Handback buttons to copy the mux CLI command to clipboard (e.g., 'mux takeover <task-id>') instead of directly calling Tauri commands. This allows users to paste the command in their terminal in the worktree directory. Also renamed CLI binary from 'agent-coordinator-cli' to 'mux'.

features.title: [EPIC] Seamless worktree takeover - work from repo root
features.description: Allow users to take over a task and work from the repo root instead of having to cd into the worktree. The goal is to seamlessly edit code in the main repo directory while changes are reflected in the worktree branch.

discussion.problem: Currently, when taking over a task, users must cd into the worktree directory, open editors there, and work in isolation. This is cumbersome when you want to quickly make changes or run the project.
discussion.vision: Run 'mux takeover' and immediately be able to work in the repo root as if you were in the worktree. Changes made in root reflect in the worktree branch.
open_questions: How to handle the branch switching? Options: (A) Checkout worktree branch in root, (B) Use git worktree tricks, (C) File sync/mirroring
What happens to uncommitted changes in root when taking over?
How to handle conflicts between root and worktree?
Should this be bi-directional sync or one-way?
How does handback work - commit changes and switch back?
What about running the project - npm install, build artifacts, node_modules?

possible_approaches.name: A: Branch checkout in root
possible_approaches.description: When takeover, stash root changes, checkout worktree's branch in root. Handback: commit/stash and checkout original branch.

possible_approaches.name: B: Rsync/file mirroring
possible_approaches.description: Sync worktree files to root (excluding .git). Changes in root are synced back to worktree.

possible_approaches.name: C: Symlink approach
possible_approaches.description: Replace root's src/ with symlink to worktree's src/

possible_approaches.name: D: Editor workspace
possible_approaches.description: Instead of mirroring, open editor (Cursor/VSCode) directly in worktree with a single command

discussion.recommendation: Start with Approach A (branch checkout) as it's the most git-native. Add safeguards for uncommitted changes. Later consider Approach B for users who need to keep root untouched.

takeover: 2. Auto-commit worktree changes with 'WIP: takeover checkpoint' message
3. Stash any uncommitted changes in repo root
4. Checkout worktree branch in repo root
5. User works in root directory normally
handback: 1. UI prompts user to commit their changes manually (with commit message input)
2. Squash/amend the WIP checkpoint commit with user's commit for clean history
4. Pop stash to restore user's previous root work
5. Resume Claude with context of what user changed

ui_integration.takeover_button: Shows confirmation dialog, then executes takeover flow. Status changes to 'manual_control'
ui_integration.handback_button: Opens modal with: (1) diff of changes since takeover, (2) commit message input, (3) optional message to Claude about what was done. On confirm, executes handback flow.
ui_integration.status_indicator: Shows 'MANUAL CONTROL' status with timer of how long user has been working

features.title: Move worktrees to ~/.mux folder
features.description: Move worktrees from being created inside/near the repository to a centralized ~/.mux/worktrees/ folder in the user's home directory. This keeps repositories clean and provides a consistent location for all Mux-managed worktrees. The folder structure should be ~/.mux/worktrees/<repo-name>/<branch-name>/.

features.title: Bulk task management - archive multiple/all tasks
features.description: Add ability to select and archive multiple tasks at once, or archive all tasks. Options: (1) Multi-select mode with checkboxes in sidebar to select tasks, then 'Archive Selected' action; (2) 'Archive All' button in sidebar header or settings; (3) Filter-aware bulk actions (e.g., 'Archive all tasks in this repo'). Should show confirmation dialog with count of tasks to be archived. Archived tasks have their worktrees cleaned up.

features.title: Smart slash command refresh
features.description: Refresh slash commands intelligently rather than fetching on every keystroke. Options: (1) Cache commands per repository with TTL-based expiration; (2) Watch .claude/ directories for changes and refresh on file modification; (3) Refresh on repository selection change; (4) Add manual refresh button in autocomplete dropdown; (5) Debounce fetches when typing '/'. Goal is to reduce unnecessary API calls while keeping commands up-to-date when user adds/modifies custom commands.
